content.comment_body: Hello. Are [product_name] devices with different FS revisions compatible? Is it possible to use the extension module [product_name] [article_no] fs:[version_no] fw:[version_no] together with [product_name] [article_no] fs:[version_no] fw:[version_no]?
All [product_name] base modules with 0BA8 are compatible with any expansion module if their article number ends with 0BA2.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is inquiring about the compatibility of [product_name] devices from different firmware/software revisions, referring to specific base and expansion modules. The reply confirms that all relevant base modules identified by 0BA8 will function properly with expansion modules ending in 0BA2, supporting documented compatibility. The focus is on whether modules from different FS revisions can be reliably mixed and used together.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects straightforward compatibility between base and expansion modules regardless of their FS and firmware versions so that expanded functionality is possible without any risk of integration or operational issues.
